notes: Second stale-note refresh, and the first one measured rather than eyeballed. Decision (118) refreshed seven notes and shipped a detector; a full sweep of every absence-phrasing family in data/edges.json found 17 stale records still standing, against the detector's zero.

★ Two of the 17 were WRITTEN by the (118) refresh itself. Refreshing the Arrow and Sen notes on 2026-07-30, it replaced 'Duncan Black is not a corpus node' with 'whether he earns his own founder edge has not been adjudicated' — and edge:duncan-black-founded-social-choice-theory had been reviewed since 2026-07-01. The false clause then propagated: the session #63 work order copied it into its slate as a task for a wave. A repair that half-fixes a record and re-states the other half as still-open is worse than the record it replaced, because it carries a fresh date.

The general failure is not a missing regex. A recorded gap can close in more than one way — a node arriving, a ruling being made, a founder edge landing, a degree claim being overtaken — and (118) watched exactly one of them. That is decision (116) in a third ledger: a record must account for every way the thing it tracks can actually end. (116) taught it for anchor terminal states and (111) for held-ledger exits.

Every repaired sentence now names node and edge IDs rather than prose names, which is what makes the deterministic detector lane able to see it next time. Measured before and after: the reworked detector reports 7 of the 17 on the un-repaired corpus and none of them are false positives. Surname matching was tried as a way to reach the other 10 and rejected — it immediately produced false positives on Fracastoro, Pasteur, Koch and Comte, and a detector that cries wolf makes 'none' worthless.

★ Live gaps deliberately PRESERVED, not swept: person:robert-hooke is still absent and both cell-biology notes continue to say so; edge:bertrand-russell-founded-type-theory still records that Whitehead holds no type-theory edge; edge:louis-pasteur-founded-microbiology still records Antonie van Leeuwenhoek's absence. A gap that is still true must keep saying so.

One repair is not a gap closure but an omission: edge:bertrand-russell-founded-analytic-philosophy annotated two of three co-founders as corpus nodes and silently left G. E. Moore unannotated, which reads as absence. No regex can detect absence-by-omission; it is recorded here as a known limit of the mechanism rather than as something the detector will catch.
